notes.title: Hotfix for shadows
notes.content:
Hi all,
The last update broke the shadows in the game so one puzzle was not solvable :(
(I know the crew of Babylon 5 would love for the shadows to stay away but hey...)
I fixed the issue and also made some performance improvements.
Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: A few improvements
notes.content:
Hi everyone, the update to v2.2 contains the following:

- new: autosave after each puzzle unlock, you can choose between your manual and the auto save when loading (so they are two separate savegames)

- new: 8 players per room allowed (not sure if it is stable, let me know! Take care of your toes!)

- new: first batch of Portuguese translation (thanks to Marina Herrmann)

- new: 100% leaderboard for speedrunners of room 2 (Barbara's secret), you have to solve every puzzle, the order is not important. You can check the state by pressing F1, when there is no hint left you can leave

- fixed loading with missing savegame

- fixed duplicate resolutions in settings

- fixed shadow opacity, so it won't make it impossible to read things

- fixed the hugeness of the shoe (just a little bit :D)

notes.title: Fix for first door
notes.content: - in some cases the door would not open for every player in multiplayer mode, which should now work

notes.title: Logging for achievements and hints
notes.content:
- better logging for achievements, if you are still having trouble unlocking certain achievements please send me your log file. it is called "output.log" and can be found here: C:\Users\YOUR_USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Bitbeast Games\Escape Room - The Sick Colleague
You can send it on the Discord or in the Steam forums or send an email to info@bitbeast-games.com
Thanks! :)

- more robust hint system, now showing less hints for already solved puzzles

- changed the placement of some objects so you won't get stuck or the meaning of them becomes clearer

notes.title: Part 2 release date announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37742201/52669ed4b5830a7b9d7611ed94c7b72ce9758d6c.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

Almost 19 months ago, the first part of "Escape Room - The Sick Colleague" got released. I never imagined it to be so popular and only your positive feedback kicked off the development of part 2. Thank you for that! It feels like ages ago and I have to thank you for your patience in not knowing an exact release date. So today I am very happy to be able to tell you, that part 2 will be available the next week on the 6th of April! :)

My initial plan was to not only release the game but also two very minor DLCs you can spend money on if you want to support the game. However, I am still waiting for my new tax ID to arrive to be able to set a price for the DLCs on Steam. This has led to the situation for the last few days that I am not releasing a free game for which some of you have been waiting a long time for the reason of... money. And this seems ridiculous to me. So I won't delay it any longer and put the game out now and the DLCs a bit later.

I hope you like the new room and that it is in a state you can play without any major bugs. The testing team did a really good job of pointing things out that are fixed now before you have to suffer through them (if you want, come to the Discord and thank the testers for suffering for you :D). I also want to give a special thanks to Urwis12 and Abdullah Ali Waleed for not only testing a lot but also helping on the Discord and being very helpful in discussing issues regarding the game.

Not everything is finished though and there will be a few updates in the next weeks. Some translations are still missing and Spanish will be the next one to arrive. Also, the possibility to rebind the controls in-game is planned as a future update.

Like I said above, there will also be two very optional DLCs so nobody gets left behind regarding the main game. I will announce them later on but here is a short hint of what is planned for them:

[h3]Supporter DLC[/h3]
Here you can buy a highly decorative support sticker that will show up in-game. You can also print it out and put it on your jacket, you will be regarded as highly sympathetic at parties :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37742201/be9f0cc563fb8319a9e859d4835d7f2b81b358fc.gif[/img]

[h3]Character pack DLC[/h3]
For the multiplayer mode, this pack contains six new characters to choose from. They are all very intelligent so puzzle solving will be easier than ever :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37742201/0b44fb854978ebdbc5e6d6be191e981993559c4b.png[/img]


Thank you very much for your company on this journey! It has been stressful at times but also quite fulfilling. :)

notes.title: Inviting your friends has never been easier
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37742201/6e4f7bde53f58a4c1f61f6b088fa41c2aedd184a.png[/img]

Hi all,

There are a few things in this update, but the biggest one is a new invite button. It appears when you create a room and you can invite your friends using the Steam overlay using it. Sounds simple and every game has it but it was very nerve-wracking to implement :D I tried to test it as well as I can with two laptops but like always, if you find anything broken, let me know.

In other news, these issues also got improved:
- the mouse is less sensitive in zoom mode, this helps a lot with aiming at small things (thanks to tinyoverflow for the suggestion)
- some missing parts of the translation were added or updated (mainly Italian, big thanks to Gabriele Farrotti and Luca Cassinelli)
- the avatar is now hidden when crouching, this should eliminate... weird... situations :D
- the crosshair will now be animated when you can use an object you are carrying with another object you are looking at
- the object preview now rotates with the player (better or worse?)
- it also rotates in small increments if you turn the mouse wheel
- few small bugfixes e.g. when putting stuff into the drawers etc.

notes.title: Saving is now enhanced
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37742201/dd68c9fb5884e19346f61fd4c7487a1b3c18c2df.png[/img]

Hi all,

This update enhances the saving and loading capabilities a lot. So far, only the state of the locks got saved but from now on the position and state of almost everything is stored. That way, you can save your beautiful artworks you created with the items (post a screenshot!) or even the mess you leave behind :D
Your old saves are still functional and get converted the next time you save.

You can save and load anytime during the game and the best part is, it works in multiplayer as well. If you load a game, every player gets the same state. This can also be used to update the room for everyone should items run out of sync (e.g. a door is open for one player and not for the other). The room state is also synced to everyone at the start of a multiplayer game so for example, you can play the game alone for some time then invite some friends and continue together. If you find any issues let me know, I am sure there are some scenarios that can cause new glitches.

Additional to that there were a few other small improvements listed below. I hope this helps you in your escapes!


- two players grabbing an item at the same time should result in the item dropping on the floor so it won't get stuck in your hands
- ask if you want to save on quitting the game
- no more object preview when you can interact with an item
- added some hints in the UI, how to join a room, using F10 etc.
- show last changes in the main menu when hovering over the version number
- fixed rotating of objects (hold R)
- fixed the vase ;)
- fixed the reset of certain objects when using F11 to reset everything
- fixed some colliders

notes.title: It's the litte things...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37742201/eac562c81af0645f3e3cad49727d44f66e653d68.png[/img]

Hi all,

Update 1.17 has a few adjustments in store:

- there is a second high score list for players who play for the first time and finish in a "normal" time. So they should not get drowned in the mass of speedrunners. Those can continue to battle for rankings in the old list. I know, would have been nice to have this from the start but some things seem obvious only in hindsight.

- the new hotkey F10 can be used anytime now to deactivate the automatic controller detection. There were some cases where broken controllers, flight sticks/HOTAS, or 3D mice were sending input that the game recognized as a controller. So if your mouse cursor disappears in the menu or you are running in circles in the game, just press F10 and see if that helps.

- the help system ist more robust now so you should not receive hints for puzzles that you already solved

- in the main menu there is a new button above the version number showing some (very useful) statistics. To be honest, I just wanted to try out the statistics system of Steam :D so right now you can only see how many games were played or finished by you or all players but maybe it will see some additions later like traveled distance, thrown objects, etc. What would you like to see there?

- movement in the multiplayer mode should now be more smooth due to a higher update rate

- the clock is synced to all clients in multiplayer mode so all players will have the same time at the end no matter when they joined the game. The mysterious 0 seconds high score should be a matter of the past now (at least coming from that glitch, I am sure you will be creative to find other ways :)

Have fun!

notes.title: 2nd multiplayer update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37742201/69ffc6120fd20c2054c90fde48148f8d3d1a4283.png[/img]

Hi all,

In this update, four more characters move into the Escape Room. Well, they are not living there... but you can choose one of them for the multiplayer part. I would like to make this collection of heroes a bit more diverse so if you know any good 3d models in a similar style (but also cheap) you want to see and play in the game, let me know.

On top of that, South America and Russia are now available as server regions where you can gather around. The needed data rate for playing multiplayer was lowered a bit to support the users with lower bandwidth.

Last not least like always there are a few tiny adjustments based on feedback to make the game more clear and more bug-free.

notes.title: Multiplayer update (alpha)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37742201/aa42fb679f21d211f4af7073062422a60951246c.png[/img]

Hi all,

Finally, the first version of the multiplayer mode is available. ːlunar2019smilingpigː
Testing the multiplayer aspect of the game and making it rock-solid is not an easy task to do so I decided to release this early version to get your feedback from real-life sessions.

The game can be completed together but a few things are missing and most likely there will be bugs. Please report those here, in the forum, or on the Discord so I can take care of them.

Since the game is free to play I can only afford to cater for 100 simultaneous players (total over all sessions), so if you are not able to connect: please try again later ;)

In the future, there will be more models to choose from and more server regions will be available as well.

For now, have fun escaping together!

notes.title: Controller update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37742201/5f19339dfdde231325db2ccd3ad65404e6a82985.png[/img]
Hi all,

With the recent update you now have the option to play the game using a controller. You can switch between mouse/keyboard and controller just by using one of those.

The controller offers a seamless zoom but does not cover possible keyoard shortcuts that can differ from object to object e.g. rotating code wheels with 1-5 or typing code numbers directly while holding the safe.

If you find any bugs or have suggestions for improvement let me know in the discussions or on Discord.
